summary: Saward Dawson is a Blackburn, Melbourne chartered accountancy (Russell Bedford member) with 70-80 staff, audit-led but with a business advisory team that handles client accounting, reconciliations and cloud-app setups. It has written publicly that it is exploring AI tools, and is expanding into Sydney in 2026. Business Advisory Partner Shervy Dahliana is a Certified Xero Advisor who works with NFPs on reconciliations, BAS and GST.

claims.quote: We’re expanding our Saward Dawson footprint into Sydney!

claims.quote: Saward Dawson is a Melbourne accounting and business advisory provider supporting family businesses and not-for-profits with tax, audit and strategic advice.

hooks.text: Shervy leads reconciliation, BAS and GST work for NFP and small business clients and the firm offers regular reconciliation review as a service line: she owns the workflow Vert automates.
Firm says it is continually exploring AI tools and promotes connected cloud apps; the APAC case study stresses automation with clearer controls.
Sydney expansion and new partner appointments signal growth in headcount and client load.

risks.text: Audit and assurance is the firm's lead service; the primary contact (Jeff Tulk) is an audit partner, so the draft goes to Business Advisory Partner Shervy Dahliana instead.
The firm already builds connected-app ecosystems (Hubdoc, ApprovalMax, Futrli) and is exploring AI, so it may have preferred tools and its own views on audit trail and controls.
Weak-to-moderate fit per account notes: no standalone bookkeeping or outsourced-finance line.

gaps: No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content found for Shervy Dahliana or Jeff Tulk (Shervy appears on a CMA conference faculty page only).
No job ads for bookkeeping or business advisory roles found; only a Sydney auditor ad.
Xero partner status for the firm itself not confirmed beyond individual Certified Xero Advisors.
Business advisory page contains placeholder text ('[insert link here]'), so its tool list may be dated.

first.subject: Reconciliation work at Saward Dawson
first.body:
Hi Shervy,

Saward Dawson's business advisory page offers clients a regular review and reconciliation of their records, and your profile says you work with not-for-profits on reconciliations, BAS and GST. Vert reconciles and cash codes with a traceable audit trail, turning hours of manual reconciliation into minutes. With the firm expanding into Sydney, I'd love to learn how much of that client reconciliation work still lands on your team each month. Open to a 10 min walkthrough this week?

Best,
Dawoud
